main_topics.reason: The user came for practical strategies for fibro fog at an accounting job, and most of the conversation centres on it.
The user asked whether to tell their employer and about a middle path, which took several turns and shifted their view.
The user described waking repeatedly and returned to sleep as the foundation to fix.
The user raised snoring and breathing pauses reported by their husband and decided to book an evaluation.
The user disclosed nightly diphenhydramine and asked whether it was a problem, which the bot flagged as possibly contributing to fog.
The user asked in one turn whether any medication or supplement treats the fog.
The user opened by saying they were scared of losing their job, and this framed the conversation.
The user called losing their train of thought in meetings mortifying and asked for in-the-moment help.
The user mentioned once being frustrated that no one flagged the antihistamine earlier.

output.summary: A user with fibromyalgia worried about losing their accounting job to worsening brain fog and asked for practical strategies. The bot gave workplace tactics, explained disclosure options and confidentiality through HR, and flagged possible sleep apnea and the nightly diphenhydramine as issues to raise with a doctor. The user said the plan was clear and thanked the bot.
